text:
oliver: Heads-up — Aurelia Systems confirmed we can start the Early Access next week. NDA signed (uploaded to partner portal). Need bench plan + telemetry spec by EOD Fri. @maria can you lead?

maria: Got it. I'll draft the test matrix. Need their baseline configs + power envelope. @tony-partner can you drop the HW spec and any shipping notes?

tony-partner: Dropping specs now. Rackable 8x-A100 equiv nodes, 256GB host RAM, NVLink passthrough. NDA file: aurelia-NDA-v2.pdf (in portal). Will share access creds after Monday once rack is staged.

sana: For benchmarking, propose these workloads: throughput generation (long sequences), latency_p99 chat (interactive), and memory-stress with 16k context. Include quantized and FP16 variants. Quick bench command we plan to run: 
```bash
./run_bench.sh --model redwood-3b-q4 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 1000
```

maria: Telemetry hooks we need: token latency per stage, GPU util by kernel, PCIe error counters, CPU steal, and memory throttling events. Tag runs with `aurelia-ea`. @devops-bot can you spin up a dashboard and retention?

devops-bot: @maria dashboard `partnerships/aurelia/bench` created with 30d retention. Alert rule added: p99 gen latency > 300ms -> page oncall.

emily-legal: Quick legal reminder — scrub any raw logs for partner IPs, host serials, and user IDs before sharing. Use LegalShare for NDA docs and keep track of document approvals.

oliver: Timeline check — bench runs Wed-Thu, compile report Fri morning, review with Aurelia Fri afternoon. Hardware shipping ETA Mon AM. Maria you own the runbook?

maria: Confirmed. I'll produce a runbook (private drive) and a creds flow doc. Expect ~6h soak per variant; running parallel variants across two racks.

tony-partner: We'll enable remote KVM during the EA week. We can also run an initial calibration on our side and share CSV perf outputs if that helps.

sana: Prefer Redwood run the official scripts for repeatability, but we'll accept their CSVs to cross-validate. For integrity, please include sha256sum(report.csv) on any CSVs you share.

oliver: Also, no press or socials until joint comms review signoff. @emily-legal please prepare the announcement checklist and quote approval flow.

emily-legal: On it. I'll draft the comms checklist and route it to marketing -> partner -> legal for approvals.

maria: Uploading initial test matrix now to the private drive link (sharing with infra and @oliver). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abc123 (internal). Will update when creds are live.

tony-partner: Shipping tracking: 1Z999AURELIA.ETA Mon 09:30 PST. I'll DM tracking updates to @maria.

sana: I'd like to add a small microbench for cache-thrash (very quick, low-cost) to help debug memory regressions. Anyone object?

oliver: Go ahead. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Notice: scheduled maintenance in us-west-2 Tue 02:00-04:00 may impact remote KVM. @tony-partner please confirm alternate window if KVM is required then.

tony-partner: We can move KVM to Tue 05:00-08:00 PST. Confirmed.

oliver: Great — thanks everyone. I'll compile action items and ping later today with a shared checklist.
